about: Stacked claims (coordinator, Part 16; classify.mjs offSiteVerdicts `stacked`, matrix.mjs judge): a violation on a line where Solid's first throw halted the run before the rule's own code could fire. A violation means "wrong if it runs", so such a row is no false positive by itself, but the halt is no evidence either: a (first code, rule) pair scores `stacked-claim` only when a pattern here, with the first throw removed and the rule's condition kept, makes Chrome report a code of the rule. Every pair's patterns are checked on each patterns run (patterns.mjs `stackedProblems`): each must be judged fine with a code of the rule. A pair not listed scores false-positive.

CLEANUP_IN_FORBIDDEN_SCOPE|missing-owner.why: a helper an owned tracked scope and an ownerless caller both run: with the tracked caller gone, the ownerless call reports NO_OWNER_CLEANUP

PRIMITIVE_IN_FORBIDDEN_SCOPE|sync-comput.why: createMemo(async, { sync: true }) where creating is allowed: SYNC_NODE_RECEIVED_ASYNC

PRIMITIVE_IN_EFFECT_CALLBACK|sync-comput.why: as above, out of the effect callback

PRIMITIVE_IN_EFFECT_CALLBACK|missing-own.why: an effect's apply callback has no owner: an owner-needing call that creates no primitive there reports NO_OWNER_CONTEXT and NO_OWNER_CLEANUP

NO_OWNER_CONTEXT|missing-context-provide.why: useContext with an owner and no provider: CONTEXT_NOT_FOUND

MISSING_EFFECT_FN|leaf-owner-forbidden-c.why: the createEffect given its effect function, in an action onSettled runs: PRIMITIVE_IN_FORBIDDEN_SCOPE
